title: Could you share any dietary guidelines or mealtime customs I should be mindful of during my stay?

segments.text: To ensure a comfortable and respectful dining experience for everyone, please keep the following guidelines in mind: ​Vegetarian Policy & Snacks: Only pure vegetarian food items are permitted within the premises. You are welcome to bring your own snacks, and there is no restriction on bringing food, provided it is vegetarian. ​Designated Dining Area: All meals and snacks must be consumed in the reception area. To preserve the purity and sacredness of our main spaces, eating inside the main hall or the havan area is strictly prohibited. ​Hygiene: Please ensure you clean up after eating and do not litter. Help us keep the reception and dining areas clean and tidy for everyone. ​Meal Options & Tiffin Services: ​Many generous devotees voluntarily sponsor and contribute meals during the Mahotsav, so cooked meals may often be provided on-site. ​If you prefer home-cooked style food, have specific dietary restrictions, or choose not to eat the sponsored meals, you can ask a volunteer for contacts to local tiffin services. ​You are also welcome to order via food delivery apps (like Swiggy or Zomato) or visit nearby restaurants. ​Kitchen Usage & Self-Cooking: ​While your busy schedule during the event may leave little time, if you wish to prepare a simple snack or a late-night bite, the ashram kitchen is available for use. ​Please strictly follow the posted guidelines (Do’s and Don’ts) inside the kitchen regarding usage, safety, and maintaining cleanliness to ensure a smooth cooking experience for everyone.
